thesis: John Collison argues that while technology companies often focus on studying the history of tech to surf multiple waves, non-technology conglomerates demonstrate that high-growth, multi-business models are possible outside of Silicon Valley. He contrasts the typical tech approach of either tightly integrating acquisitions or maintaining loose venture capital-style relationships with the common non-tech model of holding independent businesses under one structure while sharing expertise and management styles without deep integration.
